TA0064.title: Dark Web Marketplace Operator
TA0064.description: Organizations or individuals that operate underground marketplaces over existing anonymity networks such as Tor or I2P. They manage listing rules, product approval, transaction matching, and escrow mechanisms, but do not build the anonymity networks or general-purpose attack tools. These platforms facilitate trade in stolen data, malware, exploit tools, attack services, forged documents, and other illegal goods, while using cryptocurrency payments, mixing services, and anonymity networks to conceal participants and fund flows.
